default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win11cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win11cis_rule_1_1_7 }}
file:
  win11cis_1_1_7_cleartextpassword:
    title: "1.1.7 | Ensure 'Store passwords using reversible encryption' is set to 'Disabled' | ClearTextPassword"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win11cis_snapshot_dir }}\SystemAccess.ClearTextPassword'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^0$/'
    skip: {{ if not .Vars.win11cis_domain_joined }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      workstation: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.1.7
      NIST800-53R5:
        - IA-5(1)
        - SC-28
        - SC-28(1)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/cis_1.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/cis_1.1.x/cis_1.1.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.1.7 | PATCH | Ensure Store passwords using reversible encryption is set to Disabled"
  when:
    - win11cis_rule_1_1_7
    - not discovered_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_1.1.7
    - NIST800-171_3.13.16
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-28
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-28_1
  community.windows.win_security_policy:
    section: System Access
    key: ClearTextPassword
    value: 0
